user_job: Open stock, movement, lot, search, count and reorder workflows through clear controls.
personas_and_grants: Active local farm session; preserve each existing persona's destination and command grants

scope.species_kind: Existing route's explicit species/module; N/A for menu chrome
scope.subject: Existing selected record/route; menu never fabricates a subject

navigation.deep_link_authorization: Unchanged native farm/record authorization; no new deep link or grant
navigation.back_and_draft_behavior: Existing navigation callbacks; shared page back control is now visible before content; no business draft ownership moves

design.illustration_use: Original approved family assets only where already applicable

copy.policy: Concise action labels; preserve identity, units, safety and truthful receipt text

adaptive_layout.phone: Scrollable content within existing insets; compact controls use governed 48dp targets
adaptive_layout.tablet: Existing responsive layout preserved; no separate data/command model
adaptive_layout.large_text: Wrap labels and chips, retain user font scale; summaries stack at large text
adaptive_layout.outdoor: Existing outdoor tokens and 64dp minimum controls

queries.name: Existing scoped inventory read model
queries.loading_empty_error: Retain existing loading/error/empty contract; sync unknown is not zero
queries.freshness: Local host projection; no invented remote freshness
queries.offline_source: Room/SQLite and immutable local operation journal

actions.label: Existing inventory navigation callbacks; no posting or FEFO changes
actions.intent: Existing navigation or explicit user selection
actions.command_or_destination: Existing inventory navigation callbacks; no posting or FEFO changes
effects: Navigation or existing governed command only
actions.idempotency: Navigation is read-only; writes retain their existing operation identity
actions.success_receipt: Existing owning screen's truthful local receipt
actions.failure_and_recovery: Retain existing error and retry route

state_matrix.expected_ui: Truthful empty state with working relevant controls
Data-backed content and exact destination callbacks

not_applicable_states.reason: This contract changes presentation/navigation; existing query and command authorities retained

accessibility_tests: Native light/dark/outdoor, narrow/large text capture review; acceptance remains pending until evidence recorded
